Attached: 1 image

Gitea has released version 28.2, addressing multiple security vulnerabilities and general bug fixes.

Affected: Gitea instances.

Details: Developers disclosed 12 vulnerabilities in total, with nine fixed in 28.2 and three patched in earlier releases.

Notable issues include an SSH authentication flaw and an OpenID account association risk.

Upgrade recommended.
